title: A lisse locus for a constructible sheaf
statement: Let $k$ be a field, let $X$ be a scheme of finite type over $k$ [def-weil-field, def-pc-scheme, def-weil-finite-type-morphism], and let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring. Let $F$ be a constructible sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on $X_{\mathrm{et}}$, with constructible and lisse as in [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes]. There is an open subscheme $U\hookrightarrow X$ [def-weil-open-immersion] such that $F|_U$ is lisse and, if $X\ne\varnothing$, then $\dim(X\setminus U)<\dim X$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. If $X=\varnothing$, take $U=X$.

proof.text: Use the same Stratification already stored in IsConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf. On each stratum, apply finite_locally_constant_module_values_iff to obtain IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf. Package these witnesses as IsConstructibleSheaf; no conversion of partitions or scheme structures is needed.

Apply generic constancy in ModuleCat over the same coefficient ring to obtain a dense open U whose restriction is finite locally constant. This works for the empty scheme too. If X is empty, extensionality on its points shows that U is the top open, proving the empty-scheme clause.

For the dimension clause assume X is nonempty. The finite-type structure morphism to Spec k gives local Noetherianity and compactness of X. The finite-dimensionality result topologicalKrullDim_ne_top_of_compactSpace excludes top. The closure of any chosen point is a nonempty irreducible closed set, excluding bottom by Order.krullDim_ne_bot_iff. Recursion on WithBot and ENat therefore writes topologicalKrullDim X as a natural number d.

The complement of the open U is closed. Density gives interior(U complement) = empty, hence it is nowhere dense by IsClosed.isNowhereDense_iff. Apply the nowhere-dense dimension-drop theorem with dimension d, and rewrite d as topologicalKrullDim X. The complement is allowed to be empty.

proof_origin.place: R3 Lean proof: existing finite-value criterion, generic constancy for all schemes, finite dimension and nowhere-dense dimension drop; empty clause by extensionality.

lean.statement: theorem exists_lisse_open_dimension_drop (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ] (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (hF : IsConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf F) : ∃ U : X.Opens, IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) U.ι).obj F) ∧ (Nonempty X → topologicalKrullDim {x : X // x ∉ U} < topologicalKrullDim X) ∧ (IsEmpty X → U = ⊤)
